notes: The "Updated to X" rail notice shows only when the running build is X. The marker (localStorage monocode.installedUpdate) is written when a download is ready and again when the user asks for the restart, before anything is installed; the next boot consumed it blindly, so a failed install relaunched 1.0.200 with "Updated to 1.0.205" in the rail beside "Update to 1.0.205" in the sidebar. consumeInstalledUpdate now takes the running version (main.tsx reads it over the existing app:version IPC alongside the boot workspace) and drops the marker without a notice when they differ; the install failure itself is the updater status's job (next commit). Test added for the mismatch and the match. Verified: typecheck, full vitest (2365), build.
